text: Every time I try to export our monthly board report to CSV, the web app crashes with a blank white screen. Lost 2 hours of work yesterday!
Exporting to PDF fails silently. The spinning wheel runs forever and no file downloads. Our clients need these reports weekly.
CSV export is completely broken for projects with more than 100 tasks. Throws an internal server error every single time.
Love the dashboard views, but the PDF export cuts off the rightmost columns and corrupts data formatting.
Tried exporting data for our board meeting and the CSV export button was completely unresponsive. Had to copy paste manually.
Export report functionality is so buggy. It works once out of five attempts, usually timing out with a 504 gateway error.
Google Calendar sync keeps disconnecting every 3 days. I miss team meetings because task deadlines do not update on my calendar.
Calendar two-way sync creates duplicate events whenever a teammate reschedules a deadline. My calendar is a mess.
The Google calendar integration constantly shows auth token expired. We have to re-authenticate our entire team every week.
Deadline sync with Outlook and Google Calendar is terribly delayed. Changes take up to 4 hours to reflect on my phone.
Sync between Google Calendar and milestones stopped working completely after the last update. Urgent fix needed!
Push notifications on iOS are completely broken after updating to iOS 18. Nothing arrives unless the app is actively open.
Mobile app crashes instantly whenever I open a task that has images or PDF attachments. Unusable on iPhone 15.
I do not receive any notification badges on my Android device. Missed several high-priority ticket assignments from my manager.
The iOS mobile app is extremely laggy on scroll and crashes about twice a day during field inspections.
Notifications arrive 2 hours late. Real-time collaboration is impossible when push alerts are this delayed.
App crashes every time I upload a photo from the camera roll on iPad. Please fix this critical bug.
We loved the product until renewal time when our pricing increased by 65% with zero advance notice. We are actively migrating our team to ClickUp.
The mandatory 10-seat minimum is absurd for small boutique agencies. We only have 4 staff members but are forced to pay for 10 full licenses. Will cancel if not resolved.
Billing charged our corporate credit card twice this month and support took 9 business days to acknowledge and issue a refund.
Too expensive for what it offers. You lock basic features like custom reporting and activity logs behind the exorbitant Enterprise tier.
Price hikes every year with very few actual improvements to the core workflow. Seriously considering cancelling our enterprise contract next quarter.
Hidden fees for API access were never mentioned during sales demos. Very dishonest pricing model.
Please add a native Slack bot integration so our team can create, assign, and update tasks directly from Slack channels.
We desperately need deep Slack integration with interactive buttons to approve requests and comment without opening the browser.
A Slack app that posts daily task digests into project channels would save our team at least 30 minutes every morning.
Would love to see two-way sync with Slack threads and task comments. Right now our conversations are fragmented between two tools.
Slack bot notifications for @mentions in task descriptions would be game changing for our engineering team.
We desperately need automated recurring tasks (daily, weekly, monthly). Recreating repetitive sprint maintenance tasks manually every Monday is tedious and error-prone.
Lack of recurring tasks is the only reason we haven’t rolled this out to our accounting team. We have monthly financial closes that need automated schedules.
Feature request: Recurring checklists and templates for weekly client status check-ins.
Why is there no repeating task option? Even basic todo apps have this. Please implement recurring task rules soon.
Recurring tasks with custom cron intervals or flexible day-of-month scheduling would make this tool complete for operations teams.
Dark mode for the mobile app please! Using the app late at night or during night shifts literally blinds my eyes.
Web version has dark mode, so why does the iOS mobile app still only have blinding bright white? Please support system theme.
I do most of my triage at night. A true OLED dark theme on Android would be greatly appreciated.
Please add dark mode to the tablet and phone apps. It is 2026 and this should be a standard feature.
We need custom outgoing webhooks triggered on task creation and status change so we can automate our deployment pipeline.
Can you provide an official Zapier or Make.com integration? Connecting our CRM leads to project tasks currently requires messy custom scripts.
Outbound webhooks with HMAC signature verification would allow our security team to safely integrate with internal audit systems.
API rate limits are too restrictive (60 req/min) for data synchronization. Please add webhooks to reduce constant polling.
Customer support response time is abysmal. Waited 4 days just to receive a templated link to an outdated FAQ page.
Support rep was completely unhelpful when addressing our billing issue. Rude and dismissive attitude.
Live chat is never actually live. It just asks you to leave an email and promises a reply within 24 hours that never arrives.
The onboarding interactive tour was fantastic! Our 15-person marketing team learned the basics in less than 20 minutes.
Documentation is clear, step-by-step videos made training new hires seamless. Great job on the knowledge base.
The search bar is painfully slow. Typing in a project name freezes the entire UI for 3 seconds, and partial word matches do not work.
Global search often fails to find tasks created earlier in the same day. Search index appears to be desynced.
Loading boards with more than 80 cards takes over 8 seconds. Our team experiences frequent browser tab memory warnings.
UI is smooth and snappy on small projects, but crawls to a halt when switching between large team workspaces.
CloudFlow has transformed how our product team operates. Kanban boards with swimlanes are gorgeous and fast.
The best project management tool we have used in 7 years. Clean UI, intuitive keyboard shortcuts, and rock-solid collaboration.
Custom fields and tag filters are so flexible. We replaced Jira and Trello in one sweep and saved $12,000 annually.
Super clean interface! The markdown support inside task descriptions is implemented better than Notion.
Gantt timeline view is a masterpiece. Managing cross-functional dependencies across 6 departments is finally painless.
We love the real-time presence indicators. Seeing teammate avatars on task cards prevents duplicate work completely.
Great software if you enjoy guessing whether your edits actually saved or got eaten by a sync error. Stellar experience really.
Oh wonderful, another price hike right after our export button stopped working. Money well spent as always.
The design looks like it was handcrafted by angels, but the backend performs like it is hosted on a microwave.
Fantastic app for solitary hermits since notifications never inform you when teammates assign urgent tasks to you.
Exporting filtered tables to CSV drops all custom field values.
Data export feature fails when date range spans more than 6 months.
Can you please fix the CSV export timeout? Our quarterly compliance audit is delayed because of this.
Attempting to download Excel report yields a 0KB corrupt file.
We need a reliable way to bulk export our project history. Right now export crashes 80% of the time.
Export to CSV produces strange UTF-8 encoding errors with non-English characters.
Calendar events created by CloudFlow appear 1 hour off in daylight savings time.
Sync with Outlook 365 calendar fails with authentication expired error.
Google Calendar sync deletes our client meetings if the task status is moved to archived.
Recurring calendar sync creates duplicate calendar entries on Apple Calendar.
Calendar sync latency is intolerable. Deadlines updated at 9am show up at 1pm.
iOS notification badge count is always stuck on 99+ even when all notifications are cleared.
App randomly logs me out on iPhone when switching between WiFi and cellular data.
Android push notifications arrive without sound or vibration despite system permissions.
Opening task comments on mobile app crashes if comment contains a mention.
The mobile UI feels clunky on iPad mini. Buttons overlap the bottom navigation bar.
Offline mode on mobile doesn’t work. Cannot view downloaded tasks on airplanes.
Cancelled our team subscription today. A 50% price increase during a tough economic year is unacceptable.
We are considering alternatives to CloudFlow due to seat pricing tiers forcing us into unnecessary licenses.
Our team of 6 had to pay for 10 users. When we asked sales for a 6-seat plan, they refused flatly. Goodbye.
Billing renewal failed and customer accounts were immediately locked out without grace period. Terrifying for business operations.
Enterprise tier pricing is opaque. Sales rep quoted one price and contract came back 30% higher.
We love CloudFlow, but our whole company lives in Slack. A native Slack integration for task updates is critical.
Would be great to receive personal DM alerts from a CloudFlow Slack bot when assigned a task.
Please build a Slack slash command like /cloudflow new [task title] to quickly log tickets.
Integrating with Slack channels for automated milestone announcements would boost team morale.
Our marketing team runs sprint planning bi-weekly. We need recurring task templates that auto-populate every two weeks.
Cannot use CloudFlow for recurring compliance routines without recurring task automation.
Recurring tasks please! It is the number one requested feature on your public community board.
Having to clone task templates manually each month is painful and waste of management time.
Dark theme on iOS mobile app would make reading tickets in low light so much easier on the eyes.
Can you please implement dark mode on Android? The white background is blinding at night.
Great app overall, but missing dark mode on iPad is disappointing in 2026.
Please support outgoing webhooks so we can sync tasks with our GitHub and GitLab pull requests.
Zapier integration would let us pipe customer bug reports from Typeform straight into CloudFlow boards.
Need webhooks for automated billing reconciliation whenever a project milestone is marked complete.
Support took over 5 days to respond to an urgent project permission lock issue.
Tier 1 support staff don’t understand technical questions and just copy paste generic documentation.
Customer success manager was outstanding during our enterprise rollout. Very patient and knowledgeable.
Help center search results are outdated. Many articles still reference the legacy v1 navigation.
Global search takes 4 to 5 seconds to load results in workspaces with over 200 tasks.
Search by tag is broken. Clicking on #urgent shows zero results even though multiple tasks have that tag.
Page load times have gotten noticeably slower with each recent release.
Filtering tasks by assignee causes high CPU usage and browser lag on Chrome.
The UI design is by far the cleanest in the industry. It makes daily task management a joy.
Subtask nesting and dependency arrows in the timeline view are flawless. Incredible productivity boost.
Saved our remote agency over 10 hours a week in status sync meetings. Absolutely love this tool.
Keyboard shortcuts are super responsive. I can navigate and create tasks without touching my mouse.
Our designers and developers finally agree on a single tool. CloudFlow bridges the gap beautifully.
Customer feedback boards and client portals are sleek. Our clients love the transparent progress view.
Fast, reliable, and modern. Transitioning from Jira was the best decision our team made this year.
Permissions and role-based access control work exactly as advertised. Easy for external contractors.
Solid features and nice layout, but occasional lag when drag-and-dropping cards between columns.
We like the Kanban view, but the lack of custom automations forces us to do too much manual maintenance.
Great desktop application, mediocre mobile companion app. Hope the mobile team catches up.
Has potential to beat Monday.com, but the support responsiveness and pricing transparency need serious work.
Good tool for startups, but enterprise security features like SAML SSO are gated behind top-tier pricing.
CSV export repeatedly fails with a timeout when filtering large date spans. We really need this fixed for audits.
Export button does not respond on Safari browser. Works on Chrome but completely dead on Safari.
Google calendar sync loses sync token every Monday morning. Every team member has to reconnect manually.
Calendar sync causes infinite loop notifications when two people edit the same task description simultaneously.
iOS notification badge does not clear until phone is restarted. Very annoying glitch.
Mobile app crashes whenever I tap on the attachments tab of any task card.
Renewed our contract only to discover seat pricing jumped from $12 to $20 per seat without notice. Thinking of churn.
Forced to buy 10 seats for a 3-person dev team. Either offer flexible seat packs or we are moving to Linear.
Slack integration would literally double our team adoption rate. Please prioritize building a Slack app.
Can we have Slack unfurling for CloudFlow links? Pasting task links in Slack currently shows nothing.
Recurring tasks are essential for our sprint retrospectives and weekly client status calls. Where is this feature?
Please let us schedule recurring tasks that repeat on the first business day of every month.
Dark mode for iOS and Android apps is desperately needed. The white theme hurts when checking tasks in bed.
Would love custom webhooks to notify our Discord server when a bug is marked resolved.
Customer service wait times are ridiculous. 72 hours for a simple password reset confirmation.
Search filter dropdown closes itself whenever you select a second option. Terrible UX bug.
Speed and responsiveness on web are unmatched. Best task tracking experience on the market.
The team collaboration features are smooth. Dragging tasks between sprints is effortless.
Gorgeous interface and wonderful keyboard shortcuts. Makes project management enjoyable.
Fantastic Kanban boards, but please give us a dark mode option on our mobile devices.
Nice tool, but having no recurring tasks and a broken CSV export makes month-end close painful.
Everything is great except customer support, which takes days to reply to basic billing tickets.
Love the real-time updates and task dependencies. So much better than Jira for agile teams.
Exporting our team dataset to CSV consistently crashes our browser. Needs urgent developer attention.
Google calendar sync disconnected again. Missed our client sync call this morning.
We were charged for 15 seats instead of 10. Billing support has not responded for 4 days.
Can we get native Slack bot alerts when comments mention @channel or @here?
Automated recurring tasks would save our project coordinators at least 5 hours every single week.
Dark mode on iOS would be a dream. Otherwise the app is nearly perfect.
Webhooks for task state transitions (In Progress -> Review -> Done) are a must for CI/CD automation.
Search is sluggish when searching across multiple projects. Takes way too long to return results.
Onboarding was smooth and our whole company adopted it within a week. Highly recommend!
The visual project timelines and Gantt chart view are truly best-in-class.
Sarcastic applause for the export feature that corrupts files right before executive presentations.
Billing surprised us with a massive renewal rate hike. Looking at Asana and ClickUp today.
Recurring tasks and Slack bot are the two missing pieces preventing this from being a 10/10 tool.
Calendar sync fails silently without any error prompt, leaving you to wonder why meetings are missing.
Mobile app crashes on launch after updating to latest version. Reinstall did not fix it.
Very intuitive navigation and lightning fast search inside task cards. Great engineering work.
The pricing jump without any new enterprise features feels like price gouging. Disappointed.
The 7-step onboarding wizard is so confusing; it forced me to invite 3 teammates before I could even see the workspace dashboard.
Workspace hierarchy is completely unintuitive. What is the difference between an Organization, a Workspace, and a Folder? Our new team is completely lost.
Invite links expire after only 10 minutes! Half our invited engineers received expired token errors before they could set up their passwords.
Sign-up wizard froze during the initial project template selection step. Had to refresh twice and restart account creation.
As a first time user, finding how to create a simple private project was buried 4 menus deep. The initial onboarding tutorial skips permissions entirely.
Super clean onboarding UI! Took less than 3 minutes to import our backlog from Trello and start running sprint planning.
Team invite emails are landing in Spam folders for Google Workspace users. Took us 2 days to realize why new teammates hadn't joined.
After 3 years on the Enterprise plan, hitting a surprise 65% price hike on renewal and 10-seat minimums is forcing our procurement team to review alternative vendors.
We have over 200 tasks in our quarterly board. Exporting to CSV locks up our browser tab with 100% CPU usage every single time.
